svg:
Oblique / 2D Doppler: only line-of-sight components matter
S (v_s) <line x1="200" y1="180" x2="240" y2="160" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width:1.5"/> v_s at θ_s to line SO
O (v_o) <line x1="550" y1="180" x2="510" y2="200" stroke="#0b7a4b" stroke-width:1.5"/> v_o at θ_o to line OS
line of sight f' = f * (v - v_o cosθ_o) / (v - v_s cosθ_s) θ_s = angle between v_s and SO (source to observer), θ_o = angle between v_o and SO? Convention: cos positive when component along line toward other Sign rule: numerator + if observer moves toward source, denominator - if source moves toward observer. Use projection, not total speed. Special: closest approach → cosθ=0 instant, but derivative gives frequency glide. Valid: far-field, |v|<v_sound, straight-line motion
